e3.source: recall-coverage data/chain/e3/usdc_utilization (virtual underlying balance at every state-changing block), read every 5 minutes
e3.fullLockRule: first block at or after the exploit with utilization >= 99.9% (the dataset E3_LOCK_UTILIZATION)

calm.source: venue-stress/history.json aave-core-usdc cash, hourly, outside the stress windows and E3

oracleChange.note: Config-card oracle-dimension history (since each subject's collection start) plus parameter diffs between the registry snapshots, through fromRegistryChange. Read-access grants (TollGranted) and tightenings are not messages. Bridge, admin and mint dimensions are out of scope for this rule.

governanceChange.definition: A holder of the collateral at HF 1.30 under the threshold in force just before each change; changes inside 24h merge into one message at the worst severity. A threshold raise and a change on another collateral are not messages.

aaveV3EthereumCoreEmode.note: Aave v3 Ethereum Core e-mode changes (an asset dropped from a category, a category threshold set), for a holder in that category at HF 1.30. Per asset-month over the asset listing span: an upper bound, since few holders use each category.
